description: FIBO 派生预处理语义索引（SSOT 派生产物）。正本=custom/server/ontology/ontology-fibo.ts 的 fiboQgateIndex()，由 scripts/fibo/sync-qgate-index.ts 再生成本文件；一致性守门=custom/server/ontology/__tests__/ontology-fibo-ssot.test.ts（漂移即红）。锚定 FIBO master_2026Q3（2026-10-20 发布）与 OMG Commons；Authorization/Capture 为工程近似（无 IRI，不冒充 FIBO）；不做运行时 RDF/OWL 推理（OD-004）。

concepts.label: Party
concepts.definition: 个人或组织（FIBO 已把 Party 迁移到 OMG Commons，不在 fibo- 命名空间下）（原文：person or organization）

concepts.label: Agreement
concepts.definition: 两方或多方经协商达成的理解，体现各方对承诺的要约与接受（原文：negotiated understanding between two or more parties, reflecting the offer and acceptance of commitments on the part of either party）

concepts.label: Contract
concepts.definition: 有行为能力的各方自愿、审慎达成的协议，各方同意受法律约束并提供对价（原文：voluntary, deliberate agreement between competent parties to which the parties agree to be legally bound, and for which the parties provide valuable consideration）

concepts.label: ContractualElement
concepts.definition: 构成协议不可分割组成部分的元素（安排、条款、要求、规则、规格、标准等）（原文：element, such as an arrangement, provision, requirement, rule, specification, and standard that forms an integral part of an agreement）

concepts.label: ContractualCommitment
concepts.definition: 规定缔约方约定事项的条款，即一方作出的履行某行为或义务的承诺（原文：provision specifying something that the contracting parties agree to, i.e., a promise or pledge made by one of the parties to perform some action or fulfill some duty）

concepts.label: Commitment
concepts.definition: 某方作出的作为或不作为承诺（原文：promise made by some party to act or refrain from acting in some manner）

concepts.label: Duty
concepts.definition: 施加于某个主体的义务（原文：some obligation which exists and is imposed on some individual）

concepts.label: PaymentObligation
concepts.definition: 按合同条款支付一定金额的可依法强制执行的义务（原文：legally enforceable duty to pay a sum of money according to the terms stated in a contract）；FIBO 多重父类：Commitment + Duty；本包取 Commitment 作单继承父类（模型限制，已如实登记）。

concepts.label: Payer
concepts.definition: 支付账单/费用，或向收款方付款以部分/全部履行义务的一方（原文：a party who pays a bill or fees, or who makes payments to a payee in partial or complete fulfillment of an obligation）；FIBO 父类 Obligor（未纳入本包）。

concepts.label: Payee
concepts.definition: 应收款的一方，或收款方付款的受领人（部分/全部履行义务）（原文：a party to whom a debt should be paid, or to whose order a bill of exchange, note, or check is made payable, or who receives or will receive a payment from a payer in partial or complete fulfillment of an obligation）；FIBO 父类 Obligee（未纳入本包）。

concepts.label: ContractParty
concepts.definition: 已订立有约束力协议、按约定承担义务/责任并享有利益的法律上适格的参与方（原文：legally competent party that has entered into a binding agreement, accepting and conceding obligations, responsibilities, and benefits as specified）；FIBO 父类 PartyRole（未纳入本包）。

concepts.label: Payment
concepts.definition: 为履行义务（如清偿索赔或债务）而交付货币的行为（原文：delivery of money in fulfillment of an obligation, such as to satisfy a claim or debt）

concepts.label: PaymentEvent
concepts.definition: 涉及为履行义务而交付货币的事件（原文：an event that involves delivery of money in fulfillment of an obligation）；FIBO 父类 TransactionEvent；FIBO 区分事件类目（OccurrenceKind）与事件实例（Occurrence）。

concepts.label: TransactionEvent
concepts.definition: 销售、转让、租约、许可、贷款、垫款、出资或其他对财产（有形或无形）或货币权益的转移，无论交易以何种方式达成、条款是否成文（原文：any sale, assignment, lease, license, loan, advance, contribution, or other transfer of any interest in or right to use any property (tangible or intangible) or money, however that transaction is effected, and regardless of whether the terms of the transaction are formally documented）；FIBO 无裸 Transaction 类，交易语义的 FND 泛化锚即本类（OccurrenceKind 子类）；账户流水级单笔事件见 IndividualTransaction，证券市场语境见 MarketTransaction。

concepts.label: PaymentSchedule
concepts.definition: 为履行义务而交付货币的时间安排（原文：schedule for delivery of money in fulfillment of an obligation）；FIBO 父类 Schedule（未纳入本包）。

concepts.label: MonetaryAmount
concepts.definition: 以货币单位表示的一定金额的度量（原文：measure that is an amount of money specified in monetary units）；FIBO 父类 ScalarQuantityValue；金额与币种是两个独立关系（hasAmount / hasCurrency）。

concepts.label: Currency
concepts.definition: 交换价值媒介，按其货币主管当局的地理位置界定（原文：medium of exchange value, defined by reference to the geographical location of the monetary authorities responsible for it）；FIBO 父类 MeasurementUnit；ISO 4217 币种代码见 CurrencyIdentifier。

concepts.label: ContractLifecycleEvent
aliases: 合同生命周期事件（类目）
concepts.definition: 在协议生命周期一个或多个阶段发生的事件类目（原文：kind of event that occurs during one or more stages of the lifecycle of an agreement）

concepts.label: ContractLifecycleEventOccurrence
aliases: 合同生命周期事件（实例）
concepts.definition: 特定合同生命周期特定阶段中事件的实际发生（原文：actual occurrence of an event during a specific stage of a specific contract lifecycle）

concepts.label: Settlement
concepts.definition: 完成交易的行为，包括但不限于完成会计处理、交换对价和/或依法登记文件（视情况而定）（原文：act of finalizing a transaction, including but not limited to finalizing accounting, exchanging consideration, and/or legally recording documents, as applicable）；FIBO 的 Settlement 是合同生命周期事件类目，不是「金额状态」；扣款完成 ≠ 结算。

concepts.label: SettlementEvent
concepts.definition: 完成交易或其一部分的具体事件，包括但不限于会计处理、交换对价和/或依法登记文件（原文：specific event involving the finalization a transaction or portion thereof, including but not limited to finalizing accounting, exchanging consideration, and/or legally recording documents, as applicable）；FIBO 把 SettlementEvent 建模为 Settlement 类目的实际发生（exemplifies），不是 Payment 的同义词。

concepts.label: SettlementTerms
concepts.definition: 定义交易一方或多方结算承诺与机制的合同条款（原文：contract terms that define the commitment to and mechanism for settling one or more sides of a transaction）

concepts.label: Account
concepts.definition: 与定期交易和服务的商业安排相关联的记录容器（注意：是记录容器，不是资金容器）（原文：container for records associated with a business arrangement for regular transactions and services）；FIBO 父类 FinancialRecord；账户是记录容器，余额/持有人/提供方都是独立关系。

concepts.label: CustomerAccount
concepts.definition: 代表具名、可识别的一组余额与累计值、用于汇总客户在指定期间交易活动的账户（原文：account that represents an identified, named collection of balances and cumulative totals used to summarize customer transaction-related activity over a designated period of time）

concepts.label: AccountHolder
concepts.definition: 拥有账户的参与方（原文：party that owns an account）；FIBO 父类 PartyRole（未纳入本包）。

concepts.label: AccountIdentifier
concepts.definition: 标识账户的标识符（原文：identifier that denotes an account）

concepts.label: AccountProvider
concepts.definition: 提供并维护账户服务的参与方（原文：party that provides and services an account）

concepts.label: IndividualTransaction
concepts.definition: 具有货币影响、并记录在与账户关联的记录中的事件（原文：event that has a monetary impact and is documented in the records associated with an account）；FIBO 的 IndividualTransaction 是账户流水的单笔事件，不等同于 MarketTransaction（Informative 的交易概念）。

concepts.label: TransactionRecord
concepts.definition: 与账户关联的交易记录（原文：record of transactions associated with an account）；FIBO 父类 Record / Registry（未纳入本包）。

concepts.label: Balance
concepts.definition: 可用或应付的金额（原文：amount of money available or owed）

concepts.label: Merchant
concepts.definition: 以营利为目的购销他人生产的商品的参与方（原文：party engaged in the purchase and sales of goods produced by others for profit）；FIBO 父类 FunctionalBusinessEntity；本包上提到 Party 以保持层级连通（已如实登记）。

concepts.label: Identifier
concepts.definition: 在其关联对象范围内唯一标识该对象的字符序列（FIBO 已迁移到 OMG Commons）（原文：sequence of characters uniquely identifying that with which it is associated）

concepts.label: LifecycleStatus
concepts.definition: 指示某物在其生命周期某一时点所处位置或状态的分类器（原文：classifier indicating the position or state of something at a particular point in its life-cycle）；FIBO 无裸 Status 类；本概念取代「Status」这一口头泛称。

concepts.label: Occurrence
concepts.definition: 事件类目的一次实际发生（即事件实例）（原文：happening of an OccurrenceKind, i.e., an event）；FIBO 的基础区分：事件类目（OccurrenceKind）vs 事件实例（Occurrence）；Payment 属于后者。

concepts.label: MarketTransaction
concepts.definition: 定义以某种对价供给可流通标的的任何交易；有本金方与对手方，因而不对称（原文：Any transaction which defines a supply of some negotiable item in return for some Consideration. The Market Transaction has a Principal and a Counterparty, i.e. it is not symmetrical.）；FIBO 无裸 Transaction 类；该概念成熟度为 Informative，仅作对照，不建议作为交易主键。

concepts.label: Authorization
concepts.definition: 卡支付流水线中的可撤回资金保留：授权额度 ≠ 已扣款额度（FIBO 全仓无对应类；属 ISO 8583 / PSP 领域概念）。注意：FIBO 无 Authorization 类（全仓 code search 0 命中）。保留本概念是为了和 Capture/Settlement 做语义区分；不得标注为 FIBO。

concepts.label: Capture
concepts.definition: 把已授权额度转为实际扣款的动作：扣款 ≠ 结算（FIBO 全仓无对应类；属卡支付 API 术语）。注意：FIBO 无 Capture 类（全仓 code search 0 命中）。语义门用它区分 capturedAmount / settledAmount；不得标注为 FIBO。

constraints.description: 退款不得超出已扣款金额（候选不变量，P5+ 由 persistence 门执行侧落地）
结算金额不得超出已扣款金额
分录借贷合计相等（复式记账不变量候选）
